## Database metadata

| Term                  | Meaning                                                                         |
|-----------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Schema                | A named namespace for database tables and other objects.                        |
| Metadata              | Descriptions of schemas, tables, columns and constraints.                       |
| Connection provider   | A function that opens a DBI connection when called with no arguments.           |
| Metadata snapshot     | CSV files holding the extracted metadata for offline use.                       |
| Schema model          | An R object organizing metadata and the relationships between tables.           |

## Keys and relationships

| Term          | Meaning                                                                      |
|---------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Primary key   | One or more columns that uniquely identify a row.                            |
| Foreign key   | One or more columns that reference a key in a target table.                  |
| Dependency    | A foreign key relationship from its source table to the target table.        |
| Usage         | The same relationship viewed from the target table.                          |

## Documentation

| Term                 | Meaning                                                                 |
|----------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Atlas report         | An HTML document describing the modeled schemas and tables.             |
| Dependency graph     | An interactive diagram of tables and their foreign key relationships.   |
| Report configuration | The settings for schema selection, presentation and output.             |
